bounded_findings: 100 Hz child-launched py-spy 0.4.2 reproduced parent+child hotspot visibility 3/3 on the terminal low-privilege fixture with median wall overhead 1.0781671159029615% versus baseline.
999 Hz was operationally unstable: terminal run 0/3 successful, each returned ECHILD ('No child process') while still writing parseable profile artifacts; prior comparable run observed 2/3 success.
At ptrace_scope=1, attaching to an already-running sibling process failed Permission Denied without privilege elevation.
Successful profile artifacts exposed absolute source paths including GitHub workspace paths.
Artifact existence cannot mint profiling success when the profiler exits nonzero.
architecture_consequence: Retain only a bounded profile-observation adapter concept: explicit low sampling-rate budget, exact profiler/target/artifact identity, nonzero-exit fail-closed semantics, path redaction/classification, no automatic ptrace/SYS_ADMIN escalation, and no second executor/effect authority.
next_gate: Trigger-4 may optionally consume the result as a bounded low-rate profiling-adapter ablation; Trigger-6 does not self-promote it.
